Consumer behavior relating to Segments, channels and personalized offers. 1.4 What influences guests’ choices-location, facilities, price 1.5 How they shop - Self, OTA (Online Travel Agencies), Offline, Recommendations from family/friends 1.6 How various schemes affect decision making (Privilege Cards, Memberships, Travel Packages, Discounts, Off - Season Deals)

units.title: UNDERSTANDING BRANDING
units.topics: 2.1 2.2 What is a brand?
